cover.title: 5 Progress Photo Apps
cover.subtitle: I ranked 5 — but #3 is the only one that actually reads the photo.

caption: I ranked 5 progress-photo apps 📸 Four of them just store and line up your pics — but #3 is the only one that actually reads the photo, pulling your body-fat % and muscle scores from a single shot. That's why it's the one I open every week. GainFrame is free on iOS. Which do you use? #progresspics #fitnessapps #gymtok #bodycomposition #transformation

apps.name: Photo Compare - Before & After
apps.store_desc:
Experience the Best Photo Compare App on the App Store!

WHY YOU’LL LOVE PHOTO COMPARE - BEFORE & AFTER:

• Effortless Comparison: Quickly and easily compare your photos side by side.
• Intuitive Design: Enjoy a clean, user-friendly interface designed for smooth navigation.
• All-in-One Solution: Everything you need for detailed photo comparisons, all in one app.
• Customizable Tools: Enhance your comparisons with a variety of customization options.
• Seamless Sharing: Instantly share your photo
apps.description: Does one thing well: clean before-and-after comparisons. But it only lines your pixels up — it never reads them.

apps.name: Selfie A Day - Everyday Photo
apps.store_desc:
Selfie-A-Day is a history of you. Take a selfie every day and play them back in fun, life capturing movies.

Instantly play your selfie movies inside the app and save them directly to your Camera Roll or share to Instagram, Facebook, Twitter and Tik Tok.

Already have a bunch of selfies? Easily import them into the app from your Camera Roll. 

The Backup feature saves all of your photos to your Camera Roll for safe keeping. 

Use our built-in camera grid or ghost image view to line up your face
apps.description: Turns daily selfies into a time-lapse of your change. A great habit-builder, but it leaves the interpreting to you.

apps.name: MyFitnessPal: Calorie Counter
apps.store_desc:
Achieve your nutrition, calorie, macro & fitness goals with MyFitnessPal – the AI-powered food & fitness tracker with everything you need. Calories, macros, food, workouts – track it all in one place with one of the most comprehensive health, nutrition & fitness tracking apps available. Now with a built-in AI nutrition Coach for personalized guidance based on your goals and history. Plus GLP-1 journey support - log doses and set reminders in the app.

Create personalized fitness & nutrition goal
apps.description: A calorie-tracking giant that happens to store progress photos. Fine if you're already there, but the photos are an afterthought.
